about_the_game:
“In a world where all Players grow stronger, only one remains at Level 1.”

Introducing a stylish action roguelite game that reimagines Kakao Entertainment's popular web novel and webtoon. Join us for this unique adventure coming to PC and consoles.

An Era of Infinite Growth, However...

In a world where mysterious towers and dimensional gates have appeared, select individuals "awaken" as Players with unlimited potential. But Kim Kigyu is different. After five years, he remains the only Player stuck at Level 1. When a special gate that only he can enter appears, secrets that could shake the world begin to unfold.

Cross-Dimensional Stylish Action

Experience immersive combat with stunning 3D graphics and free camera control powered by Unreal Engine 5. Everyone can enjoy stylish action through dynamic combat systems, spectacular animations, and impressive effects.

Strategic Growth and Challenge

While leveling up is impossible, a diverse progression system utilizing roguelite elements awaits you. Discover new combat styles with each attempt and enjoy strategic battles through the Ego Shard (Perk) system. With intuitive controls, anyone can learn and enjoy the game, but mastery offers even greater rewards.

Corrupted Guardians of the Ether

Within the tower, powerful bosses with tragic pasts await you. Erebor's 4-phase combat patterns driven by obsession with ancient weapons, the Motherer who seeks to devour everything through endless proliferation... Lodrix wandering the boundary between darkness and light, Primer who went mad with elemental power, and at the center of it all lies the Etherblade.

Uncover the secrets of the tower imbued with Ego Shards. Collecting and utilizing the powerful Ego Shards hidden on each floor will be key to defeating these mighty bosses.

Endless Challenge and Fun

At its core, this is a game about crafting diverse combat styles through swift and spectacular action. Through unique combinations of Ego Shards, players can forge their own distinct fighting style, while roguelite elements ensure each playthrough offers fresh experiences.

The game's essence lies in its stylish action and strategic build crafting through Ego Shards. True to its action roguelite roots, it's designed to reveal new layers of enjoyment with each subsequent playthrough.

With spectacular combat effects and intuitive controls, anyone can easily learn and enjoy the game, but the depth of gameplay offers greater enjoyment based on skill level, and a special adventure awaits you.

short_description: The Player Who Can't Level Up is an action roguelite game based on web novels and webtoons of the same name. You can freely combine various combat styles and numerous growth factors to become stronger. Experience unexpected enhancement effects through various random elements.

English*, Korean*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Indonesian, Japanese, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Thai, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Portugal, Portuguese - Brazil
*languages with full audio support
